overview: Force Projection is a master-level dark side technique classified under Illusion. Projects a false image or duplicate of oneself—or another person—across great distances to deceive, intimidate, or misdirect enemies. Sith holocrons recorded projection techniques used by ancient Lords to appear in multiple places simultaneously during wars.
history:
Force scholars trace Force Projection across eras recorded in holocrons, Jedi Archives data-tapes, and Sith tombs on Korriban and Dromund Kaas. Practitioners documented in Films · The Last Jedi · The Old Republic · Clone Wars · KOTOR II established the modern understanding of how this ability manifests in combat, meditation, and ritual.

During the Old Republic and Sith Empire conflicts, masters drilled Force Projection into initiates as part of the standard curriculum for illusion specialisation. Surviving battle logs from the Clone Wars and Galactic Civil War show the technique adapted to blaster-era warfare, starfighter engagements, and close-quarters lightsaber duels.

In the sequel era, surviving texts and oral traditions kept knowledge of Force Projection alive even as the Jedi Temple fell and the Sith assumed new forms. Each generation reinterpreted the power through its own doctrine while the underlying Force mechanism — channelled midi-chlorian symbiosis and focused will — remained constant.

The dark side amplifies this power through passion, anger, and the will to dominate — at the cost of corruption and suffering.
significance:
Force Projection exemplifies how illusion abilities shape Force doctrine on the dark side. At master mastery, users balance raw potential against discipline, emotional control, and the moral weight of their choices.

Historians note that armies and orders rose or fell partly on how widely and wisely this technique was taught. A single master of Force Projection could turn a skirmish, break a siege, or unravel an enemy's will before blades crossed.

For students today — in academies, hidden enclaves, or alone with ancient texts — Force Projection remains a benchmark of illusion proficiency across the Star Wars saga.
